extract_pts_from_video: extract presentation timestamps from a video file using ffprobe and save to frames.txt
extract_frames_from_video: extract all frames from a video file into PNG images using ffmpeg
downscale_video_frames: downscale extracted video frames to a target size and save as PNG or raw float32
check_extracted_pts: verify that a frames.txt file exists and contains the correct number of PTS entries
sample_frame_pairs: sample frame pairs from a given frame range using specified flow operations
